notes: The auto-label (selected security + a +N badge) is a fine default, but a view that holds "Semis" or "Rate-sensitive names" or "My book" deserves to say so. Views can now be given a custom name: hover a tab and a pencil appears, or double-click the tab, or click the name in the view bar — any of the three opens a rename. Blank restores the auto-label. The name persists with the view and shows in both the tab and the view bar, and the agent can set it too (rename_view), with terminal state now reporting each view's name.
